Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Raghwendra Pratap Singh, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Indu Kumari Srivastava, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 4 20-02-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 341, 323, 504, 506, 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Petitioner, who is husband of informant/ complainant, is said to have ousted her from the matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in compliance of this Court's order dated 01.02.2023, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51172 of 2022(4) dt.20-02-2023 petitioner has paid Rs. 5,000/- to the opposite party no.2 in the Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.
He submits that the petitioner is ready to keep the opposite party no.2 as his wife as well as the daughter with full honour and dignity Chandan Kumar Singh

sentences.text: as mentioned in para 9 of the bail application
. The opposite party no. 2 is also present along with her daughter and is ready to go with her husband.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent as mentioned in para 3 of the bail application.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant provisional bail to the above named petitioner for a period of six months in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Buxar (Mahila)
P.S. Case No. 68 of 2018, subject to the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.51172 of 2022(4)
dt.20-02-2023 condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.

The learned court below is directed to confirm the provisional bail of the petitioner after filing a petition in this regard by learned counsel for the petitioner and satisfying himself that the petitioner's wife and daughter are living with him peacefully and comfortably.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) anand/-
U T Chandan Kumar Singh @ Chandan Kr. Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171885142/
